notes.note: Aggregate bank/food/non-food credit come from the fortnightly Section-42 return (all SCBs); sector/industry splits come from the SIBC return (select banks, ~95% of non-food credit). Sector totals therefore do not add exactly to non-food credit.
From 31-Dec-2025 the reporting date is month-end (Banking Laws (Amendment) Act 2025); earlier values are the last reporting fortnight, so YoY growth across that date mixes the two bases.
